infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NoB uses your location to know when you've arrived at each stop on a walking tour, so it can play the right narration automatically.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: NoB uses your location during an active walk to trigger stop narration, even if the app is backgrounded.
